description: The commerce agreement of one envelope (taifoon.commerce.agreement.v1, coord lang/cue/commerce.cue #Agreement) or of an agreement you pass: checked by the one rule (ok · invalid with the reason · missing when its kind requires one), and read as the stream prints it — the venue, job · paid amount · seller → buyer · via reseller · tx, and its legs (our fee, venue fee, seller share, premium → backers, the vault move). envelope_id reads it from the pipe (GET /v1/pipe/status/{id}); party ids, the ref and the tx read as … unless your key is a party, the sender or entitled. Free, read-only.

agreement.description: an agreement to check (a producer checking before it sends)

envelope_id.description: 0x + 64 hex: an envelope the pipe holds

name: taifoon_agreement
